subject: Re: Project Palisade — April status and a sobering number
body:
Hi Anders, Alina,

Palisade status:

- Benchmark reproduced on schedule (Mar 5). Our numbers confirm the paper's headline: both gradient-based and embedding-based TDA trail the BM25 baseline on proponent-retrieval precision.
- Our corpus slice: same ordering. BM25 hits precision@10 of 0.31, embedding-based 0.24, gradient-based 0.19 with the last-layer approximation. Amara checked whether going beyond last-layer closes the gap — gradient saturation appears to be the limiter, exactly as the release flagged, so deeper gradients buy little for 5x the cost.

The honest takeaway for the May readout: today, "provenance" is better served by lexical retrieval over the training corpus than by model-internals attribution. Thats a fine product — it's just not the sexy one. Chiara's index makes BM25-over-pretraining-corpus queryable in ~200ms, which could demo well.

Linnea
